messages:
alice: heads-up — rolling a small change for orders-svc: adding a sidecar that caches Vault secrets and refreshes them on a schedule. quick QA: do we standardize on a new annotation `secrets.redwood.io/refresh-interval` on the k8s resource, or rely on ExternalSecrets' `refreshAfter`? ideally want to avoid full pod restarts when creds rotate
raj: what's the intended refresh behavior? in-memory cache + env update? or write to projected volume?
alice: sidecar keeps secrets in-memory and POSTs to a tiny endpoint in the app to trigger reload (no file writes). sidecar will call Vault using role creds. plan is to annotate the Deployment so infra can tune intervals per env.
maria: helm chart question — if we add that annotation to the deployment template, will helm diff/upgrade show a huge change every deploy? want to avoid churn if ops tunes interval dynamically
alice: good point. plan: default annotation absent in chart; overlay (tf/helm values) sets it for prod clusters only. dev clusters will use a longer interval.
nina: are we handling race between an app reading env on start and sidecar posting? might need a readiness probe gating traffic until first fetch completes
raj: also watch projected volume consumers: some apps mount secrets as files and expect file updates. since yours uses endpoint reload, it's fine. just note this if we standardize annotation name — docs should mention behavior explicitly
deploy-bot: deploy failed in staging: sidecar crashed during auth to Vault (err=token not found). logs pasted in #deploy-automation
alice: looking. likely from missing roleBinding in staging. will open quick tf PR to bind the service account to vault-auth role

--- kubernetes annotation example ---
alice: ```yaml
metadata:
  annotations:
    secrets.redwood.io/refresh-interval: "300s"
```

--- terraform overlay snippet ---
raj: ```hcl
resource "helm_release" "orders" {
  name       = "orders"
  chart      = "./charts/orders"
  values = [file("values-prod.yaml")]

  set {
    name  = "deployment.annotations.secrets\.redwood\.io/refresh-interval"
    value = "300s"
  }
}
```
maria: quick perf thought — sidecar auths to Vault on start, then renews lease. ensure our Vault role TTL > refresh interval so we don't thrash with reauths
nina: agree. ops-oncall, can you confirm acceptable defaults for prod/staging/dev?
ops-oncall: prod=5m, staging=15m, dev=60m. if high churn apps we can lower per-service. also recommend canary: deploy to 1-2 pods first and verify no liveness flaps :thumbsup:
alice: perfect, I'll open PR with helm overlay + tf changes and tag you all. will include README note about "no file writes, app must support endpoint reload"
raj: extra ask — add a small e2e test that simulates secret rotation and asserts app reloads without full restart
maria: i'll help with e2e harness. ping me when PR is up
alice: thanks — sending PR now, will link here when ready :rocket:
